patch_description: Add a B3-spline à-trous wavelet denoising stage with correct per-scale sigma calibration between the Kalman pre-filter and the SG smoother. Wavelet shrinkage at each scale uses thresholds proportional to the true noise gain at that scale (gain_j^2 = sum of squared kernel taps at dilation j), so coarser scales shrink proportionally more noise without biasing signal structure. This directly attacks noise_reduction (currently 0.34) while adding zero group delay (à-trous is a zero-phase, non-causal-in-analysis-but-symmetric transform on the buffered window) and improving correlation, since denoising prior to SG lets the SG window operate on a cleaner signal. The finest scale is soft-thresholded hardest; scales beyond ~log2(n) are kept (trend). Floor sigma at 1e-12 to avoid division-by-zero.
